sourceText: User asked: why did B-63ba reach DONE without increasing the version number, and is that a bug? After analysis, user approved opening a small story to fix the misleading DONE version-bump skip wording.
normalizedOutcome: DONE version-bump skip output and lifecycle docs honestly explain that CLI package version bumps are skipped when no watched CLI/runtime inputs changed, even if non-runtime repository code changed.
acceptanceClaim: The old user-facing skip phrase no material code change is absent from the DONE version-bump skip path, the new phrase no watched CLI/runtime inputs changed is present, focused smoke coverage passes, and story-lifecycle docs describe the CLI/runtime version boundary without adding experiments/** to the bump policy.
